title: A Critical Evaluation of Failure in a Nearshore Outsourcing Project: What dilemma analysis can tell us
reasoning: The paper is a case study analyzing the failure of a software project using dilemma analysis. While it mentions related work on ethical risk assessment (e.g., SoDIS Inspection) as a potential future research direction, the core analysis presented does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics. The focus is on stakeholder conflicts, risks, and project management issues.
